title: Distinct logarithmic fibres and ordinary Rees powers supply moving-center jet interpolation

statement.quantifiers: Fixed positive m,K,w0,v0,theta<1 with K(w0/v0)theta^m<1; successively large weights chosen independently of arbitrary distinct nonzero multiplicative centers and additive centers.
statement.assertion: For sufficiently large admissibly divisible H, a weighted polynomial space surjects onto K prescribed logarithmic jet packets; onset may depend on the centers.
assumptions: Distinct nonzero Y-fibres, not arbitrary repeated torsion centres.
Correct weighted logarithmic multiplicity/Bezout input and explicit monomial compactification; all standard geometric imports remain externally unreviewed.
No extra K theta^m<1 condition needed in the stated distinct-fibre case.

inputs: Weighted spaces, centres, local substitution Y=y_j(1+t), X_i=c_ji+u_i+log(1+t).
outputs: A nonzero full-row interpolation minor over the relevant field; not integral-lattice surjectivity.
interface.precision: Exact eventual interpolation; centre-independent weight threshold differs from centre-dependent H onset.
costs: Parameters fixed before H tends to infinity; onset not implemented/effective uniformly.
Large weight dimensions and minors may be astronomical, not an efficient general generator.

proof_mechanism: Separate logarithmic fibres using D0=Y partial_Y+sum partial_Xi and transverse derivatives.
Weighted transverse multiplicity and exact residue constraints force a conflicting component to a constant Y fibre; at most one centre lies on it.
Bound constant-fibre divisors and construct the relevant monomial ideal I.
On blowup show A-(1+sigma)E nef, then use an explicit ample-plus-nef combination to prove A-E ample.
Use ordinary Rees powers I^n and Serre vanishing/pushdown; I^n is contained in the weighted-order cutoff, not generally equal to it.
Surjectivity over C gives a nonzero field-valued minor in the arithmetical matrix.
obstructions: Strictly nef alone is not enough to claim ample.
The Y=1 source theorem cannot be cited without reconstructing the distinct-fibre extension.
This step is reported internally reconstructed by final audit; no new intake reconstruction or formal/external certification.

potential_uses.target: Determinant irrationality arguments with moving algebraic centers
potential_uses.transfer_gate: Validate weighted geometry, fibres, exact ideal containment and norm-field descent before importing a nonzero minor.

review.source_reported: Source-scoped analytic derivations, independent reconstruction for counting/logarithm, and finite checks reported; Hamiltonian proof has source-reported review only; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
